methodology: Full original and revised page read. Major primary guidance and high-yield comparative studies prioritized; individual source access is explicit. Bibliographic checks alone do not establish clinical validity.

notes: Replaced deterministic permanent/progressive injury and universal graft/anastomosis failure with individual tissue assessment; removed fixed fractionation/dosimetry rules and unvalidated molecular-prognosis implications.
Corrected ASCENDE-RT 18.4%/5.2% from alleged stricture to cumulative grade 3 GU toxicity, with treatment and denominator scope.
Added PACE-B 2024 large randomized trial and 2026 patient-reported follow-up; explicitly separated cumulative toxicity, visit prevalence and item respondent denominator.
Added ProtecT 12-year randomized-allocation survivorship evidence, with treatment crossover, earlier RT regimen and changing sexual/urinary trajectories.
Removed RTOG–CTCAE equivalence table, universal retention/IMRT prevalence, UI misattribution of composite HR 2.76, and automatic surveillance cystoscopy language.
Replaced formalin-before-HBOT ladder with CUA severity-based approach, alum renal caution, formalin perforation/upper-tract precautions, and high-risk diversion counseling.

Corrected RICH-ART 2025 design to treated follow-up after crossover, with 39/70 actual five-year, missingness, 9 retreatments, mixed-model estimate and exclusion limits; added original 2019 comparison and qualitative Cochrane 2023 context.
Added EAU 2026 selected EPA/augmentation criteria and functional counseling; corrected Rourke 85.7% whole mixed cohort and Asghar 30/34 ureteral-unit denominator.
Removed extrapolated three-woman female urethroplasty certainty, small-series robotic superiority, universal omental necessity and diversion-referral percentages as general risk.
Corrected 2026 female pelvic-floor review outcome-specific denominators/eligibility; removed nested UUI percentage, unqualified biomechanical indices and unverified NCCN citation claims.
Replaced prophylactic PDE5 preservation claim with RTOG 0831 null preventive tadalafil finding; removed categorical implant infection claim and universal menopause prescriptions.

Identified 20 wrong/unrelated original PMID links among 24 original PMID-linked citations. All 28 intended linked source identities/available abstracts read; three unlinked NCCN entries not verified. Rebuilt bibliography to 19 used sources.
